papers.title: Compressive mechanical response and microstructures in low strain rate plastic deformation of stainless steel 316L fabricated by selective laser melting
papers.abstract: Characterization of the mechanical properties plays an essential role in the post-processing and evaluation of the functionality of the additively manufactured metallic parts. A number of studies have been focused on the tensile properties of additively manufactured metals. However, the quasi-static compression test of the additively manufactured 316L blocks with different heat-treatment conditions and scanning strategies seems to be overlooked in the literature. This paper aims to provide a comprehensive study of compressive mechanical response in plastic deformation of SS316L fabricated by selective laser melting (SLM). The mechanical response and microstructures in compressive deformation is analyzed for three printing strategies with 0°-, 90°- and 67.5°- scanning and three heat treatment conditions (450 °C for 3 h, 1100 °C for 1 h with furnace cool and 1100 °C for 1 h with water quenching) for selective laser melted (SLMed) stainless steel 316L in comparison with wrought stainless steel 316L in this work. Alteration of mechanical properties, microstructure evolution and compressive deformation mechanism is studied. Melt pool features are not significantly affected by low-temperature heat treatment (450 °C for 3 h) but fully dissolved through high-temperature heat treatment (1100 °C for 1 h). High-temperature heat treatment provides a higher resistance to compressive plastic deformation for SLMed 316L compared with the low-temperature heat-treated and as-built samples where more twinnings are observed. The compressive plastic deformation mechanism of 90°- and 67.5°-scanning samples is similar, which mainly results from twinning-induced plasticity. For 0°-scanning samples, the strong crystallographic texture is the main cause of anisotropic deformation. Modelling and simulation have been conducted to explain the anisotropic deformation mechanism of the 0°-scanning strategy. Simulation results suggest that the morphology difference of laser-scanning tracks and melt pools, which leads to material flow along the laser scanning direction, explains the anisotropic deformation mechanism.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM 316L不锈钢的压缩力学性能，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能，与生物医学植入物方向不直接相关
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue, or biomedical implant applications, and lacks surface roughness or osseointegration assessment relevant to biomedical AM.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM 316L不同热处理和扫描策略下的压缩力学响应和机制
summary_zh.method: 对三种扫描策略和三种热处理条件的SLM 316L进行准静态压缩实验和微观表征，结合模拟分析
summary_zh.result: 高温热处理提高抗压塑性变形能力，0°扫描各向异性源于强织构，90°和67.5°扫描变形机制类似
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩实验和电子背散射衍射（EBSD）验证微观结构和变形机制

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the compressive mechanical response and deformation mechanisms of selective laser melted 316L stainless steel under different scanning strategies and heat treatment conditions.
summary_en.method: Quasi-static compression tests and microstructural characterization were performed on SLM 316L with three scanning strategies (0°, 90°, 67.5°) and three heat treatments (as-built, 450°C, 1100°C) , supplemented by simulation of anisotropic deformation.
summary_en.result: High-temperature heat treatment increased resistance to compressive plastic deformation, while 0°-scanning samples exhibited anisotropic deformation due to strong crystallographic texture, and 90° and 67.5° samples deformed via twinning-induced plasticity.
summary_en.validation: Experimental compression tests and EBSD microstructural analysis validated the deformation mechanisms and simulation results.

llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structure, stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue, or osseointegration; it focuses on tribological and corrosion properties of SLM stainless steel with amorphous alloy strengthening, lacking any biomedical implant context.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究选区激光熔化不锈钢中非晶合金增强相的微观结构演变及性能。
summary_zh.method: 通过SLM制备样品，进行微观结构分析、摩擦磨损和腐蚀测试。
summary_zh.result: 非晶合金添加提高了不锈钢的耐摩擦和耐腐蚀性能。
summary_zh.validation: 实验表征验证微观结构与性能关系。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the microstructure evolution and properties of stainless steel strengthened by amorphous alloy via selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Samples were fabricated by SLM, followed by microstructure analysis, tribological and corrosion tests.
summary_en.result: The addition of amorphous alloy enhanced the tribological and corrosion resistance of the stainless steel.
summary_en.validation: Experimental characterization validated the relationship between microstructure and properties.

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Orthopaedic Center Antwerp, AZ Monica Hospitals, Antwerp, Belgium

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文为临床结局研究，未涉及股骨假体应力遮挡或微动等生物力学分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical outcomes study comparing patient-reported outcomes between low-grade and end-stage osteoarthritis, with no biomechanical modeling, implant design, stress shielding, micromotion, or FEA of any kind.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较低度与终末期髋关节炎患者全髋置换术后的疗效差异
summary_zh.method: 采用倾向评分匹配的病例对照研究
summary_zh.result: 低度关节炎患者术后功能评分与终末期患者相似
summary_zh.validation: 通过匹配患者基线特征进行对比验证

summary_en.motivation: To determine whether patients with low-grade hip osteoarthritis achieve the same functional outcomes after total hip arthroplasty as those with end-stage osteoarthritis.
summary_en.method: A matched case-control study comparing patient-reported outcome measures between groups matched on age, sex, and comorbidities.
summary_en.result: No significant differences in functional outcomes were found between low-grade and end-stage osteoarthritis groups.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through propensity score matching and sensitivity analyses.

papers.title: Advanced Ti–Nb–Ta Alloys for Bone Implants with Improved Functionality
papers.abstract: The additive manufacturing of titanium–niobium–tantalum alloys with nominal chemical compositions Ti–xNb–6Ta (x = 20, 27, 35) by means of laser beam powder bed fusion is reported, and their potential as implant materials is elaborated by mechanical and biological characterization. The properties of dense specimens manufactured in different build orientations and of open porous Ti–20Nb–6Ta specimens are evaluated. Compression tests indicate that strength and elasticity are influenced by the chemical composition and build orientation. The minimum elasticity is always observed in the 90° orientation. It is lowest for Ti–20Nb–6Ta (43.2 ± 2.7 GPa) and can be further reduced to 8.1 ± 1.0 GPa for open porous specimens (p < 0.001). Furthermore, human osteoblasts are cultivated for 7 and 14 days on as-printed specimens and their biological response is compared to that of Ti–6Al–4V. Build orientation and cultivation time significantly affect the gene expression profile of osteogenic differentiation markers. Incomplete cell spreading is observed in specimens manufactured in 0° build orientation, whereas widely stretched cells are observed in 90° build orientation, i.e., parallel to the build direction. Compared to Ti–6Al–4V, Ti–Nb–Ta specimens promote improved osteogenesis and reduce the induction of inflammation. Accordingly, Ti–xNb–6Ta alloys have favorable mechanical and biological properties with great potential for application in orthopedic implants.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究了LPBF制备的Ti-Nb-Ta合金多孔结构，通过降低弹性模量匹配骨骼刚度，并验证了成骨细胞响应，非常契合AM生物医学植入物的研究方向。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not report fatigue testing, surface roughness quantification, or explicit finite element analysis of stress shielding.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发新型钛合金骨植入材料以减少应力遮挡。
summary_zh.method: 采用激光粉末床熔融制备不同成分和取向的Ti-Nb-Ta合金及多孔结构。
summary_zh.result: Ti-20Nb-6Ta合金弹性模量降至43 GPa，多孔结构进一步降至8 GPa，且促进成骨分化。
summary_zh.validation: 压缩力学测试和人类成骨细胞培养（7和14天）。

summary_en.motivation: To develop novel Ti-Nb-Ta alloys for bone implants that reduce stress shielding through stiffness matching.
summary_en.method: Laser beam powder bed fusion was used to fabricate dense and open porous Ti-xNb-6Ta specimens with different build orientations.
summary_en.result: The Ti-20Nb-6Ta alloy achieved an elastic modulus of 43.2 GPa, reduced to 8.1 GPa in porous specimens, and promoted osteogenesis while reducing inflammation compared to Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical compression tests and in vitro human osteoblast culture for up to 14 days with gene expression analysis.
